command: set -eu; echo HOST=$(hostname) USER=$(id -un); echo SERVICE; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost --no-pager; echo INSPECT; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py --config /etc/entityos/entityos.conf --service entityos-vm.service inspect; echo CONFIG_BINDS; sudo -n sh -c 'grep -E "^(ENTITYOS_DATA_DIR|ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN|ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS)=" /etc/entityos/entityos.conf || true'; echo MANIFEST; if sudo -n test -f /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; then sudo -n sha256sum /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; sudo -n cat /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; else echo MANIFEST_ABSENT; fi; echo SOURCES_PRIV; for f in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/welt.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910; do if sudo -n test -f "$f"; then sudo -n stat -c 'SOURCE %n %s %Y %a %U:%G' "$f"; else echo SOURCE_ABSENT:$f; fi; done; echo DURABLE_TREE; sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state -maxdepth 4 -type f -printf '%p %s %T@\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true; echo OPEN_SQLITE_DELETED; sudo -n sh -c 'command -v lsof >/dev/null && lsof +L1 2>/dev/null | grep -E "(rootfs-run|semantic-state|\.db)" || true'; echo OPEN_SQLITE_PATHS; sudo -n sh -c 'command -v lsof >/dev/null && lsof 2>/dev/null | grep -E "/var/lib/entityos/(rootfs-run|data/semantic-state).*\.db" || true'; echo OMEGA_PRIVILEGED_READBACK_PASS=1
